name: Nehemiah
lede: The sixteenth book of the Bible, in full: Nehemiah the cupbearer weeping for Jerusalem, the night ride round the broken wall, the builders with a weapon in one hand, the wall finished in fifty and two days, Ezra reading the law from the pulpit of wood, the sealed covenant and the dedication of the wall with singing, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Wall of Jerusalem
books.blurb: In Shushan the palace word comes from Judah: the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire; Nehemiah weeps and prays; the cupbearer before Artaxerxes — why is thy countenance sad?; the king's letters and the captains; then by night, round the broken walls, and the call: let us rise up and build.

books.name: The Builders
books.blurb: Eliashib the high priest and his brethren the priests rose up and builded the sheep gate, and next unto him builded the men of Jericho — portion by portion round the wall, gate by gate, Shallum with his daughters; then Sanballat's mockery: if a fox go up, he shall break down their stone wall; the adversaries conspiring on every side — remember the Lord, who is great and terrible; and every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other held his weapon.

books.name: The Work Finished
books.blurb: A great cry of the people against their brethren — we are mortgaging our fields; ye exact usury, every one of his brother; Nehemiah shakes out his lap, and all the assembly said, Amen; then the plain of Ono — I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down; the open letter; Shemaiah shut up — should such a man as I flee?; and the wall finished in fifty and two days.

books.name: The Genealogy of the Return
books.blurb: The doors set up, and the gates not opened until the sun be hot; the city wide and large, but the people few therein; the book of the genealogy of them that came up at the first: the children of Parosh, two thousand a hundred and seventy and two, family by family and city by city; the priests, the Levites, the singers, the porters and the Nethinim; and the whole assembly together, forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore.

books.name: The Book of the Law
books.blurb: All the people gathered as one man before the water gate; Ezra the scribe upon a pulpit of wood, reading from early morning until midday — Amen, Amen; the Levites gave the sense; this day is holy unto Jehovah, for the joy of Jehovah is your strength; booths upon every roof; then fasting and sackcloth, and the Levites' prayer: thou art Jehovah, even thou alone — and yet for all this we make a sure covenant.

books.name: The Sealed Covenant
books.blurb: Nehemiah the governor and the priests, the Levites and the chiefs of the people set their seal to the covenant; the rest entered into a curse and an oath — not to buy on the sabbath, the third part of a shekel, the wood-offering by lot, the first-fruits and the tithes: we will not forsake the house of our God; then one of ten chosen by lot to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and the villages of Judah and Benjamin.

books.name: The Dedication of the Wall
books.blurb: The priests and the Levites from Jeshua to Jaddua; the dedication of the wall with gladness, with cymbals, psalteries and harps; two great companies that gave thanks going round upon the wall, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off; then Tobiah's household stuff cast out of the chamber, the gates shut before the sabbath, and the last prayer: remember me, O my God, for good.
